title: Composite Score Formula
text: The composite lead score is calculated deterministically as 0.4 * Fit Score + 0.6 * Engagement Score + 0.8 * Broker Bonus. Fit Score and Engagement Score are evaluated on a 0-100 scale, and Broker Bonus adds weighted credit when an active insurance broker relationship or referral bonus applies.

title: Qualification Tiers
text: Accounts are classified into four tiers: Priority MQL, MQL, Responder, and Disqualified. Priority MQL requires Composite Score >= 70, Annual Premium >= $1,000,000 ($1M), Engagement Score >= 15, and at least one active buying or renewal signal (and must not be disqualified). Standard MQL applies when Composite Score >= 50 without meeting all Priority MQL gates. Responder covers lower-score active accounts, and Disqualified applies to accounts flagged as disqualified.

title: Behavioral Archetypes
text: Accounts are grouped into seven behavioral archetypes: Champion (high fit, high engagement, multi-threaded across stakeholders), Achiever (high fit, high engagement, single-threaded), Watcher (high fit, moderate engagement), Dormant Giant (high fit, low engagement), Fader (lower fit, moderate or declining engagement), Lurker (lower fit, low engagement), and Detractor (disqualified).

title: Fit Score & Engagement Drivers
text: Fit Score reflects structural alignment such as renewal proximity, annual premium size, industry fit, and carrier alignment. Engagement Score captures active buyer interaction and intent signals, where low engagement on a high-fit account signals an unactivated Dormant Giant rather than poor structural fit.

title: Model Limitations & Caveats
text: High lead scores, Priority MQL status, or Champion/Achiever archetypes indicate stronger alignment and engagement correlation, but do not guarantee conversion or closed-won revenue. External factors such as broker dynamics, underwriting appetite, renewal timing, and sales execution heavily influence actual outcomes.

title: Available Charts
text: Diagnostic views cover Account Volume by Qualification Tier, SQL Conversions by Qualification Tier, Account Distribution by Behavioral Archetype, Fit Score vs. Engagement Score by Tier, and Annual Premium Pipeline ($M) by Tier.
